help.text: The bridge passes chosen data points between ioBroker installations at different sites (e.g. over VPN). Every site keeps running on its own. A site that offers data points enters them under 'Share'; a site that wants to see them enters the other site under 'Sites'. Both use the same key.

name.label: Name of this site
name.help: Shown at the other sites, e.g. Friseursalon

shareHelp.text: Data points this site offers - click the field to choose from the object tree. Choose a folder / channel / device to share everything below it (e.g. spc-edp.0.areas). Only these can be seen by the other sites, and only those with 'may switch' can be switched from there.

port.label: Port
port.help: The other sites connect to this port (allow it in the firewall / VPN)

key.label: Access key
key.help: At least 8 characters; the other sites enter the same key. It never goes over the network, the data is encrypted with it.

bind.label: Only on this address (optional)
bind.help: Empty = all network cards; e.g. the VPN address so the bridge is not reachable from the LAN

sitesHelp.text: Other sites whose shared data points should appear here (under bruecke.0.<site>.…). Address = VPN address of the ioBroker there, optional with :port (default 8102). Key = the access key set there.
